statement.notes: 1) 'advance_payments_for_purchases' mapped to 'Prepayments, receivables and other assets' (current) line item. 2) 'investment_in_securities' calculated as sum of 'Short-term investments' and 'Equity securities and other investments' (current) and 'Equity securities and other investments (non-current)' (excludes equity method investments). 3) 'accounts_receivable' not separately identified (combined with prepayments and other assets). 4) 'inventory' not separately identified (not typical for this e-commerce/services company). 5) 'short_term_debt' calculated as sum of 'Short-term bank borrowings' and 'Short-term unsecured senior notes'. 6) 'long_term_debt' calculated as sum of 'Long-term bank borrowings', 'Long-term unsecured senior notes', and 'Long-term convertible unsecured senior notes'. 7) 'accounts_payable_and_or_other_liabilities' mapped to 'Accrued expenses, accounts payable and other liabilities'. 8) 'advance_payments_from_sales' calculated as sum of 'Deferred revenue and customer advances' (current) and 'Deferred revenue (non-current)'. 9) 'total_non_current_liabilities' calculated as total liabilities minus total current liabilities. 10) 2025 USD column omitted as period/currency not requested in schema.
